summary: Regression check after mobile-only removal of react-native-reanimated + expo-router. Verified backend /api/auth/login (owner, employee, wrong password) and web login UI (invalid credentials error + valid owner login lands on /admin dashboard). All shared auth paths still work; no backend or web frontend files were modified by E1 and none were touched here. Mobile iOS keyboard crash NOT testable in this environment (requires TestFlight build).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/login response body contains only access_token/refresh_token (no user object). If the mobile/web clients ever need role at login without a second /api/auth/me round-trip, consider embedding it — currently harmless because both clients call /me right after login.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (present & populated). Owner akmaljn7@gmail.com / GeofenceAdmin123!, Employee employee@example.com / Employee123!.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 31 was a narrow regression around the mobile reanimated/expo-router removal. Backend auth + web login are healthy. The actual iOS keyboard-focus crash cannot be verified from this sandbox — it requires a physical iPhone and a rebuilt TestFlight binary; user must confirm on device.
rca of the issue: Original bug (mobile only, out of scope for this env): react-native-reanimated (transitively pulled in by unused expo-router) installed an iOS keyboard-event hook that crashed on first focus of the TextInput. Fix: removed both packages from /app/mobile (package.json), the reanimated babel plugin, and the expo-router plugin from app.json. Since both packages were completely unused, there is zero functional impact on the app; the shared REST auth path (verified above) is unaffected.
